title: Ledup section heading
description: A small taupe label over a calm geometric headline and an optional greige paragraph, centred or left-aligned. Each line fades and rises into place as it scrolls into view, the headline from further down.
notes: the paragraph can be hidden on phones, as the original does
name: ledup-heading

props.name: label
props.description: the small label above the headline

props.name: text
props.description: an optional paragraph under the headline

props.name: size
props.description: heading size on phones: md is 28px, lg is 36px (both 36px on desktop)

props.name: narrow
props.description: wrap the headline to a narrow measure (about 7 words a line on desktop, 2 on phones), as the projects heading does

props.name: textOnDesktopOnly
props.description: hide the paragraph on phones, as the original does
